title: Algebraic Expressions & Factorisation
description: Book-backed practice on forming expressions, substitution, simplification, expansion, and factorisation.

questions.q: If x represents a number, write an expression for two more than x.
questions.explanation: Two more than x means add 2 to x, giving x + 2.

questions.q: If x represents a number, write an expression for four times the number.
questions.explanation: Four times x means 4 multiplied by x, which is 4x.

questions.q: Write an expression for 7 less than y.
questions.explanation: 7 less than y means subtract 7 from y, giving y - 7.

questions.q: Kofi is 3 years older than Ama. If Ama is x years old, what is Kofi's age?
questions.explanation: Older by 3 years means add 3 to Ama's age, so Kofi's age is x + 3.

questions.q: Kojo has GHc75 more than Kofi. If Kofi has GHc x, write an expression for Kojo's amount.
questions.explanation: GHc75 more than x is x + 75.

questions.q: If 5 is added to three-fifths of a number, write the expression using x for the number.
questions.explanation: Three-fifths of x is 3x/5. Adding 5 gives 3x/5 + 5.

questions.q: Alex has 5 exercise books more than Fred. If Fred has x exercise books, how many books has Alex?
questions.explanation: 5 more than x is x + 5.

questions.q: Akua is x years old now. How old was she 6 years ago?
questions.explanation: Six years ago means subtract 6 from her present age, giving x - 6.

questions.q: Akua is x years old now. How old will she be 8 years from now?
questions.explanation: Eight years from now means add 8 to her present age, giving x + 8.
